topic: Updating dictionary file on multiple hosts
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on the process of updating `allunite_dictionary.xml` across multiple hosts. Initially, [me] noted difficulties with SFTP access permissions for the admin user. [p1] suggested using Ansible to automate the update process across all hosts. It was confirmed that no specific action is required on ClickHouse when the dictionary file is updated. The conversation concluded with a plan for [p1] to implement an automated solution.
decisions: Ansible will be used to automate the updating of `allunite_dictionary.xml` on multiple hosts.
action_items: [p1] to update Ansible code to handle the dictionary file updates across all hosts by the end of the day.
